consensus_summary: Fans generally agree that the 12/28/81 show at Oakland Auditorium Arena is a solid performance, particularly praising the latter part of the show. While it may not be as celebrated as other shows from the same week, it still offers memorable moments and a good setlist.
rating_rationale: 2.5 base + 0.1 for 12 reviews + 0.5 sentiment: While many fans enjoyed the performance, some noted it was overshadowed by other shows in the same run, leading to a more tempered enthusiasm.
